# Shell idiom handbook

Generated from measured data (shell-atlas: canon corpus + 900-repo wild corpus). Each family is a join view: ecosystem mass, canon exemplar, kinship links, dialect pair.

## How to read a record

- `wild:` ecosystem mass (units · projects · stratum) — work/wild/taxonomy.toon
- `canon:` rank-1 exemplar + exemplar count — work/cards.toon
- `sverka:` canon↔wild kinship: K links, top-2 NAMED targets by mean_sim; targets below the naming cut stay unnamed (no invented names) — work/wild/sverka.csv
- `dialect:` measured same-job pair — dialects.md; verdict words: JOB = shared task, SAME = common shape, DIFF = the stylistic delta
- `query:` live toonq/jq recipe over atlas data; `body:` unit file by coordinate

Canon and wild name spaces differ (canon "Check Root Privileges" vs wild "Privilege Check") — grep by word root and by desc words. Numbers are navigation-grade, as-of the stamp below; regenerate with `mk -C ~/projects/shell-atlas handbook`.
